tasks.title: Validation, create, alias and expiry logic
tasks.description: Review and complete UrlValidator (scheme allowlist, userinfo, 2048 limit, localhost/loopback/private/link-local/IPv6 ULA incl. IPv4-mapped), AliasValidator, secure 7-char code generation, expiresAt-in-past rejection, 409 on alias conflict via atomic add, and Location header on POST /api/urls.
tasks.expectedOutput: Updated validators, service, repository and endpoint for POST /api/urls returning correct 201/400/409 with problem details
tasks.validation: Build succeeds and the T4 create/alias/safety tests pass

tasks.title: Redirect, metadata, deactivation and owner token
tasks.description: Ensure GET /r/{code} returns 302/404/410, GET /api/urls/{code} returns metadata with isExpired and isActive without the owner token, and DELETE verifies a bearer token against the stored hash (401 missing, 403 wrong, 404 unknown, 204 success). Keep legacy GET /{code}, /stats, and DELETE routes working.
tasks.expectedOutput: Working redirect, metadata and delete endpoints with legacy routes preserved
tasks.validation: Build succeeds and the T5 redirect/metadata/delete tests pass

tasks.title: Analytics and per-IP rate limiting
tasks.description: Record clicks only on successful 302, expose totalClicks, lastClickAt and per-UTC-day clicks on /analytics using thread-safe counters. Apply the fixed-window limiter (10/60s per IP, configurable, TimeProvider-based) to POST /api/urls only, returning 429 with Retry-After.
tasks.expectedOutput: Thread-safe analytics and rate limiter wired into the pipeline
tasks.validation: Build succeeds and the T6 analytics/rate-limit tests pass

tasks.title: Tests for create, alias, expiry and safety
tasks.description: Add integration/unit tests covering FR-1, FR-2, FR-9 and the creation part of FR-4: valid create, malformed/missing url, code format and uniqueness, alias valid/duplicate/length/chars/case-sensitivity, past expiresAt, blocked schemes, userinfo, private/loopback/link-local/IPv6 hosts, over-length URL, and the Location header.
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes with all the listed acceptance cases covered

tasks.title: Tests for redirect, expiry, metadata and delete
tasks.description: Test 302/404/410 on /r/{code} including expiry via a fake TimeProvider, metadata fields and absence of the token, DELETE with correct, missing, wrong and unknown tokens, post-deactivation behaviour, and legacy routes.
tasks.expectedOutput: Passing redirect, metadata and delete tests
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes and covers every FR-3, FR-5 and FR-7 acceptance bullet

tasks.title: Tests for analytics, concurrency and rate limit
tasks.description: Test N clicks give totalClicks=N, 404/410 do not count, lastClickAt and daily buckets, 1000 parallel redirects give exactly 1000, 11th create returns 429 with Retry-After, per-IP isolation, reset after the window, and redirects are unthrottled. Check overall line coverage is at least 80%.
tasks.expectedOutput: Passing analytics and rate-limit tests with a coverage report of at least 80%
risks: Simulating different remote IPs in the test host
tasks.validation: dotnet test with coverage reports at least 80% line coverage for src/UrlShortener.Api

tasks.title: Documentation
tasks.description: Update the README with routes, status codes, request/response examples, owner token usage, rate-limit configuration, security controls, and limitations (in-memory storage, no DNS-based SSRF checks).
tasks.validation: Every documented route and status code matches the implemented endpoints and tests
